Subject: Execution of Power Purchase Agreement    
 
 
Dear Sir/Madam,  
 
In continuation of our intimation dated February 10 , 2026, we wish to inform 
that pursuant to the provisions of Regulation 30 re ad with Para B of Part A of 
Schedule III and other applicable provisions of the  Securities and Exchange 
Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 
2015 (“ SEBI  Listing Regulations ”), ACME Renewtech Sixth Private Limited, a 
wholly owned subsidiary of ACME Solar Holdings Limi ted, through its wholly 
owned subsidiary,  has executed a Power Purchase Ag reement (PPA) with Solar 
Energy Corporation of India Limited (SECI) for cont ract capacity of 300 MW, 
under Firm and Dispatchable Renewable Energy (FDRE)  Tranche VII – Assured 
Peak Power Project. 
 
The details as required under Regulation 30 of the Listing Regulations read with 
SEBI Master Circular bearing Ref. No. HO/ 49/ 14/ 1 4(7)2025-CFD-POD2/ I/ 3762/ 
2026 dated January 30, 2026, are enclosed herewith as Annexure-A. 
 
Press Release titled “ACME Solar signs PPA for 300 MW / 1200 MWh ISTS 
Connected Assured Peak Power Project” is annexed he rewith 
 
The aforesaid information shall also be available o n the website of the Company i.e. 
www.acmesolar.in. 
 
Please note that this is a voluntary disclosure.  
 
This is for your information and record. 
 
Thanking you, 
 
For ACME Solar Holdings Limited 
 
 
 
Rajesh Sodhi
